description: This Java source file defines the ModifyFeature class, which is a command object used to modify an existing Feature on a Thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, from specific parameters, and for serializing the command to JSON format. It also manages headers, resource paths, and equality checks for the command.

classes.name: ModifyFeature
classes.description: This class represents a command to modify an existing Feature in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes constructors, factory methods, JSON serialization/deserialization, and overrides for equality and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a ModifyFeature command using a ThingId, Feature, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyFeature command from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Returns the Feature to be used for modification.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing entity associated with this command.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature being modified.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Gets the JSON representation of the Feature entity.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command's payload into JSON format considering schema version and predicate.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category type of this command (MODIFY).

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization (returns false).
